release_notes: Fixes the shared scroll surface so content cannot visually jump outside its valid top and bottom boundaries.
Uses explicit pixel-position clamping rather than Tk canvas unit scrolling near short-content boundaries.
Prevents scrolling when the complete page already fits within the visible viewport.
Preserves smooth mouse-wheel behavior and precision touchpad support from v1.0.11.
Applies the fix centrally to shared scrollable screens including Dashboard, Quotation and Proforma.
The v1.0.11 update progress, visible restart/validation window, cache-revalidated manifest checks, backup validation and rollback protections remain unchanged.
Database schema remains 8; calculations, numbering, exports, document renderers, templates, revisions, and cancellation workflows are unchanged.
